Definition: from G5259 and G2224; to gird under, i.e. frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck):--undergirt.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses hypozṓnnymi where we would say to undergird, to frap with cables. In Acts 27:17, the text says "undergirding the ship."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hypozṓnnymi, I take at face value: to undergird, to frap with cables.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
